scope: GB3 298 K, ff14SB/TIP3P, 2 nm OpenMM padding, three 50 ns CUDA replicas. Measured consistency and sampling diagnostics; other proteins, chemical conditions, activity and global equilibrium require separate evidence.

retained_pilot_controls.scope: Earlier identified CPU/CUDA fixed-state agreement, preparation/charge and zero-step checkpoint restoration. These controls were retained, not rerun on the long trajectories.

environment.salt_convention: Added bulk salt excludes neutralizing counterions; integer ion counts approximate the requested concentration

periodic_cell.scope: Cell geometry and cutoff compatibility; does not establish solute-image separation or finite-size convergence

coupling_analysis.experimental_conditions: 2–4 mM GB3 in 50 mM potassium phosphate, pH 6.5–7.0, 97/3 or 95/5 H2O/D2O, 0.5 mg/mL sodium azide; source-specific measurements at 298 K
coupling_analysis.uncertainty_scope: Replica mean standard errors and half-window shifts describe these three runs. Shared starting conformation and incomplete mixing limit equilibrium uncertainty estimates. Experimental errors exclude force-field/forward-model error.
coupling_analysis.interpretation: All original 225 observations are retained. Backbone Karplus calibration partly used GB3. Passing sampling checks and matching experiment are separate outcomes; the full sampling criterion fails.

limits: Saved-frame connected-protein image checks cover neither unsaved frames nor electrostatic finite-size convergence.
The 0.05 M NaCl model approximates the experimental potassium-phosphate buffer, isotope/azide composition and protein concentration.
All replicas share a prepared starting conformation and use distinct random seeds.
The conventional constrained 2 fs trajectory has not been qualified against the zero-time-step thermodynamic limit.
Fold retention and structural fluctuation do not establish folding free energy or catalytic turnover.
